name: Sayonara Mayumi-chan ~Fujinomori Byouin Monogatari~
original_name: さよならまゆみちゃん～藤ノ森病院物語～
source:
Main character is a just assigned doctor at a countryside small hospital. In this hospital wheelchair girl Mayumi is being treated for four years from the heart disease of unknown nature. Girl is always in cheerful mood despite her state, so there's the urge to do something for her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名剛被派往鄉下小醫院的醫師。醫院中，一名坐輪椅的少女真由美正接受治療；她患有病因不明的心臟病，至今已有四年。儘管身處這樣的境況，少女總是開朗樂觀，因此讓人忍不住想為她做些什麼……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
